base_contract.resolution: verify base bytes; copy only named sections; apply explicit v3 sections; record resolved contract and actual implementation pins in run_manifest.json

synthetic_corpus.disjoint_from: all panel circuits and labels; deterministic synthetic probes only

background.bell_pairs: r=min(5,n//2); H q[i], CX q[i],q[n-1-i] for i=0..r-1; all H are exactly normalized to RX/RZ/CX
background.scrambling_layers: for layer=0..n-1: for q=0..n-1 apply RX(0.19+0.003*layer+0.007*q), RZ(0.29+0.005*layer+0.011*q); then CX a,a+1 for a=layer%2,layer%2+2,... < n-1
background.candidate_preparation_check: finite normalized amplitudes and logical central Schmidt rank >1; do not equate that rank to configured chi when internal ordering may change
background.missing_telemetry: record unknown; require actual MPS preparation-amplitude rank preflight; no maximum-throughout-word claim
background.telemetry_role: observed maximum if supported; record feasible-cap saturation or its absence; never used as panel prediction feature
background.claim_boundary: empirical probe-ensemble coefficients; no proof of full-chi cost for every entanglement trajectory or wire ordering

variable_words.two_qubit_cx_interleaved: same wrapper and background; insert CX a,b after RX and before RZ
variable_words.provenance: save background, variable word and whole-QASM counts/hashes separately; final full-register measurement unchanged

entangled_sampling_diagnostic.background: same fixed entangled preparation as operation probes
entangled_sampling_diagnostic.fit_use: never; compare shot increments only, not intercept or total preparation cost
entangled_sampling_diagnostic.poor_prediction_policy: report limitation; do not refit or select on panel labels

measurement.execution_target: C++ RepeatedExecuteOnHost internal execution plus sampling in one fresh process
measurement.within_repeat_order: 1Q then matched wrapper/CX pair; wrapper first iff (session_index_0based+repeat_order_index_0based)%2 == 0
measurement.transport: consume payload before joining with one monotonic deadline; preserve exception/hard-exit/true-timeout distinctions and close/reap resources
measurement.context_owner: actual timing worker after canonical native imports before timed API call
measurement.native_thread_policy: retain pinned library defaults; verify worker threadpool configuration including 28-thread OpenMP/BLAS defaults; record Maestro backend/shot-dependent threading; no cap tuning
measurement.context_matching: compare actual binary, libraries/versions/hashes, resolved config, CPU/affinity and declared thread policy across calibration/panel; parent imports and dynamic utilization are separate telemetry
measurement.resume_policy: reuse only v3 records with matching resolved contract/code/context/input identity; no duplicate attempts or reuse of v2 measurements

analysis.reduction: median five repetitions per cell/session; endpoint slope within session; median three session coefficients
analysis.cx_coefficient: paired CX-minus-wrapper endpoint slope/complexity; SV 2^n, MPS n*configured_chi^3
analysis.coefficient_meaning: empirical component under fixed probe ensemble; not causal gate latency or proof of complexity law
analysis.sampling_model: unweighted affine OLS on zero-state session-reduced medians; intercept is not physical launch overhead
analysis.interpolation: PCHIP in n then log2(configured_chi); no extrapolation or invalid-knot bridging; a zero-count operation does not require its coefficient
analysis.tolerance_origin: prospective local engineering QA policy, not paper thresholds or statistical significance
analysis.increment_identification: all three endpoint increments positive, their median > abs_tol, range <= max(abs_tol,rel_tol*median); CX uses paired CX-minus-wrapper increments
analysis.invalid_coefficient_policy: explicit unstable/nonlinear/unresolved/nonpositive/missing knot; never clipping or retries until positive
analysis.fit_scope: synthetic primary allocation only; no panel runtime or fidelity label for model choices

eligibility.execute_when: normalization/parser/config admissible irrespective of prediction availability
eligibility.mps_quality_failure: retain actual timing diagnostically; exclude from quality-qualified accuracy
eligibility.unsupported_normalization: retain terminal attempt; never add measurements, omit gates or change the panel
eligibility.prediction_failure: no substituted value; timing/quality can still be recorded

untimed_controls: Bell/local preparation rank for each grid config
actual worker fingerprint match and real drift rejection
technical_gates.first_ten_calibration_cells: SV n16 three words times all three repeats (9); MPS n16 chi32 one_qubit_noncommuting R512 (1)
technical_gates.before_calibration_expansion: complete remaining 8 MPS n16 chi32 word/repeat cells and SV/MPS n16 chi32 zero-state S1000 (2); 20 unique primary cells total
technical_gates.pilot_context_clock_transport_or_timing_: stop expansion and request strong review; preserve all evidence
technical_gates.stable_nonpositive_unresolved_or_nonline: retain unavailable; no favorable retry; executable panel remains measurable
technical_gates.panel_pilot: first 10 executable candidate attempts cover both engines, low/high widths including q16 and entangled input; QA before remainder
technical_gates.routine_execution_authorization: conditional on implementation, untimed controls and prescribed pilot gates actually passing under this unchanged contract
